correctness.rationale: For n>=3, G=K_n □ P3 and selected index sets A,B,C: if B≠∅, domination/semitotal iff all A,B,C are nonempty or B=[n]. If B=∅, domination forces A,C≠∅ and A∪C=[n], with precisely 2n forbidden singleton/complement disjoint pairs because their unique first-/last-layer selections are at distance three. The disjoint cases give P_n(x,y,z)=((1+x)^n−1)((1+y)^n−1)((1+z)^n−1)+y^n((1+x)^n+(1+z)^n−1)+(x+z+xz)^n−x^n−z^n−n(x z^{n-1}+x^{n-1} z). The minimal cases are one in each layer (n³); B=[n] alone (one); disjoint outer partitions for n>=4 (2^n−2n−2); 2n overlapping singleton/full outer sets (size n+1); for n=3 exactly six extra size-four outer overlapping pairs. Hence M3=28u³+12u⁴; for n>=4 M_n=n³u³+(2^n−2n−1)u^n+2n u^{n+1}, gamma_t2=3 and Gamma_t2=n+1. Independent fresh BFS-distance and deletion tests exhaustively checked all 512+4096+32768=37376 vertex subsets for n=3,4,5 and all predicted coefficients; infinite claim rests on above partition classification.
